source: Per-prop Wildbound original fed to concept generation, then concept fed to four-view generation.

prompts.concept: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: concept art for a replacement prop in the original Wildbound pixel adventure game. Input image is Wildbound's current Crypt supply crate sprite, used for its role, relative mass, materials and silhouette. Redesign it as a squat antique dungeon supply crate made of aged dark oak, reinforced with forged iron corner plates and thick rails. A small muted teal wax seal is pressed on a front slat. Flat lid, visible wide wood slats, no feet, no text. Compact rectangular plan, slightly wider than deep. Show one isolated object in a clear three-quarter game-production concept view, looking down enough to see the upper planes and with the distinguishing front facing the viewer. Painterly hard-edged fantasy game concept illustration, deliberate planes, warm key light from upper left, substantial cool shadow. Preserve Wildbound's restrained rustic character and visual hierarchy. Center the complete object on a solid dark desaturated taupe studio background, with generous breathing room. No text, lettering, annotations, frames, environment, character or other view.
prompts.orthographicViews: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: four-view pixel sprite sheet for upstream sprite-stacking visual-hull carving. Input image is the concept of the replacement Crypt supply crate. Convert the prop in that image to four accurate orthographic low-resolution pixel sprites of the same model, no three-quarter art. Single ultra-wide, strictly 1-by-4 horizontal row containing EXACTLY four drawings in this order: TOP looking straight down with front pointing DOWN, LEFT SIDE elevation with front pointing LEFT, FRONT elevation, BACK elevation. Match common silhouette dimensions: top width equals front and back width, top depth equals side width, all three elevations are same height. Preserve the overall design and simplify into crisp Wildbound-scale pixel clusters. Roughly 19 pixels wide, 15 deep and 16 high. Keep the corners square and the few plank bands readable. Shift some of the old golden brown into cool blue teal in the wood shadows. Center each isolated view inside its own equally spaced column with very large clean white gaps, and align all four by vertical center. Use only flat solid pure-white (#ffffff) background throughout, including holes and gaps. Draw in authentic low-resolution game pixel style, large consistent integer square pixels, a handful of opaque material colors, fill silhouettes with connected chunks, no soft edges. No perspective, tilt, foreshortening, partial upper surfaces in elevations, outlines around panels, text, labels, grid, drop shadows, or additional elements.
